svg.title: Structure of a product pitch card for sales staff
svg.desc: A product pitch card, fiche argumentaire, in seven blocks from top to bottom, each with its question. 1 Name: the exact name on the shelf label, legal names only if the bread meets the law. 2 Composition and method: what is in it and how it is made, the facts that justify the name and price. 3 Taste and texture: three or four descriptors from the tasting sheet. 4 Goes with: two or three food pairings, association mets et pain. 5 Keeps: how long and how to store, paper bag, never the fridge for bread, freeze cooled and wrapped. 6 Allergens: from the written allergen table, with the may-contain note. 7 The one sentence the seller says. A side panel lists sources: the technical sheet, the sensory analysis sheet, the allergen table and supplier sheets. A footer warns: no claim the bread cannot prove.

g.text: The fiche argumentaire: seven blocks, each from a document
the exact shelf name; tradition, maison, au levain only if the law is met
flours, levain or yeast, process: the facts behind the name and the price
3-4 descriptors from the tasting: crust, crumb, aroma, taste
how long, how: paper bag, never the fridge, freeze cooled and wrapped
from the allergen table, with any "may contain" note: show the table
7 La phrase du vendeur (the seller's sentence)
one or two sentences, under 30 words, that a seller can say
to a customer in 10 seconds, using blocks 1-5;
allergen answers always come from the table, never from memory
Référentiel C4.2: present composition, association mets et pain and conservation, from the technical and sensory sheets.
